rules.independent_variable: For each exact archived 64-child pool, vary only the query text sent to the unchanged reranker. One full question+context and one question-only evaluation. No rewritten query, answer term, new candidate, pooling change, score threshold or weight/k tuning.
rules.replay_adapter: FrozenPoolBackend.dense replays the fixed list to the existing single-list rerank/delivery branch. Its name and trace.mode=dense do not mean Dense retrieval occurred. Do not report its replay lookup latency as vector-search latency.
rules.validation: Original query condition for each pool must exactly reproduce its archived scores, order and evidence. Recheck candidate source/metadata/eligibility and 512 pair limit before inference; same four-unit/1200-body/4000-context delivery. Gold unit IDs used only for scoring after execution.
rules.limits: Previously exposed development queries only; not held-out, new-query generalization or Agent/task benefit. No generated model, query embedding, lexical/vector search or Abaqus. Keep failures and do not append tuned query variants within the batch.

integration_manifest.contract: Fresh retrieval uses full question+context and must reproduce archived pools exactly. Only reranker text uses question; all 15 semantic results must match fixed-pool question-only scores/order/evidence. Other routing/budget cases must preserve previous status/evidence. No further tuning, new corpus, new query, Agent or Abaqus; default unchanged.
